subject: FinApp mutual action plan (draft) — next steps & pricing ask
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finapp.com>, Alex Park <alex.park@finapp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan (draft) & next steps for FinApp POC

Hi Laura / Alex —

Great speaking with you today. Per our call, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps milestones, owners, and dependencies for the proposed 6-week POC. Highlights:

- Target kickoff: week of 7/20 (customer readiness dependent)
- Redwood to provide test model endpoint and eval harness by 7/27
- FinApp engineering to provide sample data, SSO access, and acceptance criteria by 7/24
- Target decision: production go/no-go by 9/01 (to align with your Q4 roadmap)

Please review the MAP (FinApp_MAP_v0.9.xlsx attached) and confirm owners/timing. Also callout: procurement asked about expected commit levels and potential discounts/credits for an accelerated POC -> we flagged this for internal pricing review.

Next steps we suggest:
1) You confirm internal owners and data availability by 7/14
2) Redwood sends updated MAP and pricing scenarios by 7/16
3) Quick sync (15m) week of 7/19 to lock kickoff date

Attachments: FinApp_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_draft.pdf (high-level).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finapp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Park <alex.park@finapp.com>, FinApp Procurement <procurement@finapp.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (draft) & next steps for FinApp POC

Vanessa —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. I confirmed with Alex that FinApp can provide a sanitized data extract and SSO test account by 7/22 (we need a day or two internally to prepare).

Procurement asked a couple quick questions:
- What committed spend level would unlock an onboarding credit or a pilot discount?
- Is there an option for a short-term consumption credit if we exceed initial token estimates during the POC?

We're happy with the milestones but need clarity on financials to route this to our finance/commercial owners. If you can send 1–2 pricing scenarios (recommended commit + one conservative) by Thurs 7/16 that would help.

—Laura
Laura Chen
VP Product, FinApp
laura.chen@finapp.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinApp MAP — proposed pricing scenarios

Team —

Per Laura's ask, I put together two pricing scenarios (attached as pricing_scenario_grid.csv):

Scenario A (recommended): 3-month committed pilot at $45k/month ($135k total) -> includes $20k one-time onboarding credit, 15% unit discount for duration of commit.
Scenario B (conservative): month-to-month consumption with $10k onboarding credit and standard hosted rates; no sustained unit discount.

Notes:
- Scenario A requires a 3-month revenue commit and a signed SOW by 7/30 to hit their Q4 timelines.
- If procurement pushes back, we can offer a capped consumption credit (up to $15k) for overage during the POC, paid as a post-invoice credit.

Asking Vanessa / Steph for exec approval on Scenario A discount + $20k onboarding credit and permission to present this as the recommended path.

Attachments: pricing_scenario_grid.csv

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinApp MAP — pricing/credits question

Ben / Vanessa —

Thanks for the draft scenarios. A few quick asks before we escalate for signoff:
1) Confirm financial impact: what is the expected net revenue if we apply the $20k credit vs. standard pricing for the 3-month commit? Please include simple math (ARR equivalent).
2) Does the onboarding credit require any SLA or usage minimum to be paid out?
3) Any technical risk that would require additional Redwood engineering time beyond what we've budgeted?

Once we have the numbers I'll route to Finance for a one-off approval. If it's within our established pricing guardrails I'm comfortable approving conditionally; if not, we'll need Marissa to sign off.

-Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Action: FinApp MAP v1 + pricing ask (requesting exec pricing approval)

Marissa —

Putting this in your inbox as an exec approval request. Quick summary:

- FinApp is a fast-growth mid-market customer; POC scope is 6 weeks, target decision 9/01.
- We recommend Scenario A (3-month commit at $45k/mo) to give them runway and predictable unit economics.
- Concessions requested: one-time $20k onboarding credit + 15% unit discount during commit. We also propose a capped consumption credit (up to $15k) for any POC overage.
- Dependencies: FinApp needs to provide sanitized data and SSO by 7/22; SOW signed by 7/30 to meet our target.

Attached: updated MAP (FinApp_MAP_v1.xlsx) with milestones and owners updated per Laura's notes, and pricing_scenario_grid.csv with net revenue math. Key milestones (summary):
- 7/22: FinApp provides data + test accounts (owner: FinApp)
- 7/27: Redwood provides test endpoint + eval harness (owner: Redwood eng)
- 8/03: Joint acceptance test agreed (owner: FinApp product + Redwood CS)
- 9/01: Decision meeting (owner: FinApp execs)

Request: Approve Scenario A concessions (final approval required for $20k credit + 15% discount). If approved, Ben will present Scenario A to FinApp procurement tomorrow (7/20) and route SOW for signature.

If you want a short call to discuss risk / margins I can summarize offline; I'm estimating net revenue ~ $95k after discounts for the 3-month commit (details in attached csv).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action: FinApp MAP v1 + pricing ask (requesting exec pricing approval)

Vanessa / team —

I reviewed the MAP and the pricing scenarios. Approve Scenario A with the following conditions:
1) Onboarding credit $20k is one-time, invoiceable only after kickoff and contingent on FinApp meeting the data delivery milestone (7/22).
2) 15% unit discount applies only to tokens associated with the POC endpoints (explicitly excluded from any other Redwood services).
3) Capped consumption credit up to $15k to be treated as a post-invoice credit and limited to metrics captured in our usage report.
4) Legal to insert a clause in the SOW that any additional engineering work beyond scoped hours will be billed at standard professional services rates after mutual agreement.

I trust Ben to present this to FinApp procurement. If they push materially beyond this, escalate back to me.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
